skills.descriptionEn: Turn retro Windows XP dialog states and character actions into readable, escalating visual shorts with a clear resolution.
skills.author: 山音

zh: 专业影视 / 成片制作

zh-CN.summary: 将Windows XP复古弹窗、角色动作和系统状态编排成可读且有因果收束的视觉叙事短剧。
zh-CN.howToUse: 提供创意、弹窗素材或角色参考，先确认静态图或视频路线、状态序列与文字内容。
zh-CN.outputs: 弹窗设计、状态时间线、角色动作、声音方案与视觉短剧成片。

en-US.summary: Arrange Windows XP dialog states, character actions, and system events into a readable visual short with clear causality and resolution.
en-US.howToUse: Provide the concept, dialog assets, or character references, then confirm still or video route, state sequence, and exact text.
en-US.outputs: Dialog designs, state timeline, character actions, sound direction, and the finished visual short.

skills.name: 羊毛毡故事短片
skills.description: 将故事文案转为分阶段确认的羊毛毡短片，锁定画幅、图片与视频清晰度、旁白音色和非重叠音频时间轴，并交付独立成片。
skills.descriptionEn: Turns story copy into a gated wool-felt short with locked format and image/video resolution choices, non-overlapping narration and dialogue timing, reusable visual assets, validated shot audio, and separate final cuts.
skills.author: MiniMax Design

zh: 动画 / 创作生成
音频音乐 / 创作生成

zh-CN.summary: 将故事文案转成具有羊毛毡材质、旁白对白时间轴和阶段确认的连续故事短片。
zh-CN.howToUse: 提供故事文案或剧本及可选角色场景参考，先确认画幅、声音结构和成片版本。
zh-CN.outputs: 羊毛毡角色场景、故事板、语音时间轴、自然音效与可选配乐成片。

en-US.summary: Turn story copy into a continuous wool-felt short with a narration and dialogue timeline and approval gates at each stage.
en-US.howToUse: Provide story copy or a script with optional character and scene references, then confirm framing, sound structure, and delivery versions.
en-US.outputs: Wool-felt character and scene assets, storyboard, voice timeline, natural sound, and an optional music version.
